patterns.note: A dominant, vibrant bright yellow (#FCFF52) is used as the primary background color for most sections, creating a high-energy and distinctive brand presence.
Sections alternate between the bright yellow background and softer, off-white or light beige backgrounds, often featuring centered content within a generous horizontal padding.
The navigation bar transforms from transparent with white text to an opaque yellow background with black text, sticking to the top of the viewport after a short scroll.
The hero section features a layered, torn-paper collage graphic that exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving at a different rate than the main page content as the user scrolls.

Large, elegant headings use a very thin display serif font (GT Alpina Thin/Light), creating a sophisticated contrast with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text (Inter) and a monospace font for data displays (DM Mono).
A unique horizontal 'stats bar' section presents key metrics with large numbers and descriptive text, appearing to animate or reveal as it scrolls into view.
The 'Celo's Innovation' section uses a dynamic grid of visually distinct cards, each representing a different aspect or project, arranged in a collage-like fashion.

technique_notes: The site uses scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging css-keyframes, to reveal sections with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport. The sticky navigation bar transitions its background color and text color using CSS transitions when a specific scroll threshold is met. The hero image employs a multi-layered parallax effect, where background elements move at a slower rate than the foreground content during vertical scrolling.
Text contrast is effectively managed by pairing black text with the bright yellow background, white text with dark backgrounds, and dark grey text with lighter off-white section backgrounds.

The hero section combines a large, impactful headline with a dynamic, layered collage graphic that mimics torn paper, creating a visually rich and engaging introduction that feels both artistic and modern.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin display headings (~4-5x body) are used for hero and section titles, complemented by a clean sans-serif for body text and a distinct monospace for data, with small uppercase labels for context.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and some card backgrounds.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, balanced by tighter grids for feature displays and card collections.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and pervasive use of a vibrant, almost neon yellow as the primary background color, which immediately sets it apart. This is combined with a unique 'torn paper' collage aesthetic in the hero and a sophisticated typographic hierarchy that blends elegant thin serifs with modern sans-serifs and monospaced fonts, creating a high-energy yet refined brand identity.
